mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.org_code, o.org_name, o.org_type, o.parent_id, p.org_name AS parent_name, o.sort_order, o.is_active, o.created_at, o.updated_at FROM itgc_organization o LEFT JOIN itgc_organization p ON p.id = o.parent_id ORDER BY o.sort_order, o.org_code

SELECT o.id, o.org_code, o.org_name, o.org_type, o.parent_id, p.org_name AS parent_name, o.sort_order, o.is_active, o.created_at, o.updated_at FROM itgc_organization o LEFT JOIN itgc_organization p ON p.id = o.parent_id WHERE o.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO itgc_organization (org_code, org_name, org_type, parent_id, sort_order, is_active) VALUES (#{orgCode}, #{orgName}, #{orgType}, #{parentId}, #{sortOrder}, #{isActive})
mapper.update: UPDATE itgc_organization SET org_name = #{orgName}, org_type = #{orgType}, parent_id = #{parentId}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, is_active = #{isActive} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.user_id, u.username, u.email, u.phone, u.org_id, o.org_name, u.role, u.is_active, u.last_login_at, u.created_at, u.updated_at FROM itgc_user u LEFT JOIN itgc_organization o ON o.id = u.org_id WHERE u.id = #{id}
SELECT id, user_id, username, password, email, phone, org_id, role, is_active, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at FROM itgc_user WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO itgc_user (user_id, username, password, email, phone, org_id, role, is_active) VALUES (#{userId}, #{username}, #{password}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{orgId}, #{role}, #{isActive})
mapper.update: UPDATE itgc_user SET username = #{username}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, org_id = #{orgId}, role = #{role}, is_active = #{isActive} WHERE id = #{id}
